lists.name: The New Ultimate Universe
lists.description: Jonathan Hickman's rebuilt Ultimate line in publication-adjacent reading order, from Ultimate Invasion (2023) through Ultimate Impact: Reborn.

lists.name: House of M
lists.description: Wanda Maximoff rewrites the world in Marvel's 2005 event, in publication order: the eight-issue main series, its branded tie-in mini-series, and the Decimation epilogue. Assembled from Marvel series metadata, so it covers the series Marvel branded with the event name and not the House of M chapters published in unbranded ongoing titles such as Wolverine #33-35.

lists.name: Civil War
lists.description: Marvel's 2006 superhuman registration war in publication order: the seven-issue main series plus every mini-series and one-shot Marvel branded with the Civil War name, from Front Line through The Confession. Assembled from Marvel series metadata, so it does not include the crossover chapters published in unbranded ongoing titles such as Amazing Spider-Man #529-538.

lists.name: Annihilation
lists.description: The 2006 cosmic war that rebuilt Marvel's space corner, in publication order: the Prologue, the four lead-in mini-series, the six-issue main series, and the Heralds of Galactus epilogue. Assembled from Marvel series metadata. Annihilation: Conquest is a separate 2007 sequel event and is not included here.

lists.name: Secret Invasion
lists.description: The Skrull infiltration of 2008 in publication order: the eight-issue main series plus every mini-series and one-shot Marvel branded with the Secret Invasion name, ending with Dark Reign. Assembled from Marvel series metadata, so it does not include the crossover chapters published in unbranded ongoing titles such as New Avengers and Mighty Avengers.

lists.name: King in Black
lists.description: Knull brings the symbiote god-war to Earth in 2020-2021, in publication order: the five-issue main series plus its branded tie-in mini-series and one-shots. Assembled from Marvel series metadata, so it does not include the crossover chapters published in unbranded ongoing titles such as Venom #30-35.
